entity.name: Finexus
entity.description:
Finexus – Where Banks Meet Innovation

Finexus is a next-generation Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) platform that empowers banks and fintech companies to launch new digital financial services faster, securely, and at scale.

Built on more than a decade of Al Faris International Group’s leadership in mission-critical banking integrations, Finexus offers 260+ Saudi-ready APIs that cover payments, lending, deposits, cards, wallets, trade finance, supply chain finance, payroll, collections, investments, and more. These APIs are fully aligned with Open Banking, Open Finance, and ISO 20022 standards, ensuring compliance with SAMA regulations and global frameworks.

Finexus is multi-tenant by design. This means individual bank departments (retail, corporate, SME) can run their own APIs with full data isolation, while external fintechs and third-party providers can also host services on the same platform under secure governance and revenue-sharing models.

The platform comes with a full ecosystem of tools:
Developer Portal – Interactive API documentation, sandbox testing, SDKs, and developer support.
Self-Service Portal for TPPs – Onboarding, consent and credential management, real-time analytics, and regulatory compliance tools.
Admin Portal for Banks – TPP approval, API lifecycle management, monitoring, fraud detection, billing, and subscription management.
Advanced Modules – Consent management (web & mobile SDKs), analytics dashboards, charging & billing engines, and marketplace integration for fintech, insuretech, agritech, and more.

With its SaaS deployment model, Finexus can run on leading cloud infrastructures with active-active disaster recovery, ensuring reliability and scalability.

By combining speed, flexibility, compliance, and monetization, Finexus helps banks modernize their digital offerings, enables fintechs to innovate, and creates new revenue streams through an open financial marketplace.
